about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-cis65 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: A line of the sixth bullet is lost, so the tree no longer says what to arrange with the electricity supplier.
findings.evidence: source: "arrange with the electricity supplier for overhead power lines to be shrouded (covered), or made dead or rerouted." / tree: "arrange with the electricity supplier for (covered), or made dead or rerouted."

findings.problem: The case box heading and its text, and the line See over, are run into the last bullet instead of being a separate titled box.
findings.evidence: tree: "before drilling into walls etc. What can happen if health and safety is ignored? Two experienced ground workers"

findings.problem: The two sub-bullets with the distances are given at the same level as the main bullets.
findings.evidence: tree: "• 15m (plus length of jib) if the line is suspended from steel towers; or"

findings.problem: The opening box is placed after the bullet list and the case text, but the page prints it first.
findings.evidence: tree: "Don’t let your building project strike the wrong note." placed after "See over for examples of good and bad practice …"

findings.problem: The two columns under Further information are mixed into one text, so the sentences are interleaved.
findings.evidence: source: "For information about health and safety, or to report inconsistencies" / tree: "For information about health and safety, or This leaflet is available at: to report inconsistencies or inaccuracies in www.hse.gov.uk/pubns/cis65.pdf. this guidance"

findings.problem: The Overhead power lines case text is separated from its heading and placed after the Further information text.
findings.evidence: source: "Overhead power lines A new employee without proper training parked beneath three overhead 11KV cables" / tree: "Overhead power lines" then "Further information" then "A new employee without proper training"

findings.problem: The box headings Good practice and Bad practice are joined in one note and no longer mark which picture is good or bad, and Overhead power lines is a note, not a heading.
